confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 from general knowledge of Penang prices; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Meal and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary by season and area. Local prices assume about 4.3 MYR per USD. Cocktail and wine anchors are partly scaled from beer-relative pricing where direct knowledge is weak. The FX figure comes from a web search summary of RBA exchange-rate data; the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis: comparable to other mid-sized heritage tourism cities in the region with hawker-led dining and guesthouse supply, priced somewhat below Kuala Lumpur levels.
